problems: Notes file history/polities/_notes/me-09-x.md carries each dossier's notes plus a cross-cutting list of mirrors other dossiers need (ottoman-empire Ankara 1361 against its 1363 Ahi Republic gain; fatimid-caliphate 1098 Jerusalem counterpart should be seljuks-of-syria; kingdom-of-jerusalem 1124 Tyre should name burid-dynasty; khwarezmid-empire 1224 Kerman vassal_start has no vassal_end and Sistan/Maragheh/Ahlat 1225-1230 events; ulus-of-hulegu and mamluk-sultanate mirrors; great-seljuk-empire, zengid-dynasty, timurid-empire, safavid-dynasty and ayyubid-sultanate mirrors).

Slug for the Kerman Khitan dynasty is qutlugh-khanids (validator slugify rule), not qutlughkhanids as the khwarezmid-empire notes and another report suggest; any counterpart that names 'Qutlughkhanids' or 'Burak Hajib of Kerman (Qara Khitai of Kerman)' should be read as this slug.
Wikidata ids are null in every dossier: wikidata.org is unreachable from the container.
WebFetch returns model-summarised Wikipedia text, so quoted sentences are as the tool returned them (trimmed, sometimes lightly joined); the pages themselves were opened in this run.

eldiguzids used six pages (budget five). The Eldiguzid core is drawn as Azerbaijan plus Arran (matching the great-seljuk-empire handover) with Persian Iraq as a vassal tint 1160-1194; the overlap is flagged in its notes.

nizari-ismaili-state ends in 1273 (last castle al-Kahf; Gerdkuh December 1270) rather than the infobox's 1256 so that the 1256 (Alamut) and 1271 (Mamluk) gains already in ulus-of-hulegu and mamluk-sultanate have their losses.

hazaraspids (drawn as the Bakhtiari country with a disc at Idaj) and khorshidi-dynasty (Lorestan province) divide Lorestan on the Khorshidi page's 'Little Lorestan' versus a neighbouring line 'who ruled over Greater Lorestan'; a reviewer who reads the Hazaraspids page's 'essentially in Lorestan' literally will see an overlap.
atabegs-of-yazd draws Yazd only; the kakuyids dossier's 1141 dissolve region adds Abarkuh, which these pages do not name, so Abarkuh is left unassigned after 1141.

eretnids: the Eretnids page contradicts itself in places (a ruler 'deposed by his emirs in 1354', Muhammad 'killed ... in 1390', capital Sivas versus Erzincan on the Burhan al-Din page); the dossier follows the infobox and the dated sentences and says so. The Konya loss (1352) and the Niğde/Aksaray loss (1366) are bridge entries at confidence 1.
burhan-al-din-state is the biography of Kadi Burhan al-Din; 'Burhan al-Din State' is the page's own phrase. The ottoman-empire 1395 Sivas-region gain precedes this state's 1398 end.

No dossier was written for the Hamdanids of Sana'a (page not found), the Ayyubid principalities of Hama, Homs and Kerak (no article for the principality opened) or the Mar'ashis (stub page); Jabrids and Usfurids are already inside bahrani-dynasty and Kathiri belongs to me-10.
Every confidence-1 entry (bridges over page silence) is marked 'page silent' in its note; low_confidence_events in each dossier's counts are those entries.
